checks.message: Provisional constraint status is disclosed in proposal, figures, visual, sources, assumptions, and metrics.
All three key areas retain provisional_constraint and official_boundary=false.
The partition is derived from one site polygon using difference/intersection operations; coverage is complete without overlaps.
Core areas and ratios are recomputed in EPSG:4548 from the submitted geometry.
Both language versions are offline static HTML with local assets only.
Narrative, report HTML, visual HTML, and A3/A0 drawings have aligned Chinese/English versions; figures are bilingual-neutral.
All scenario cards define data minimization, human review, stop/rollback conditions, and conceptual status.
All required chapters contain claim-adjacent evidence anchors and retain the structured audit layer.
Contributor self-check rerun covers deterministic validation plus spatial, visual, and professional reviews; all gates pass, review_status is formal-review-ready, and next_actions is empty.
Participant preflight confirms branch, submission scope, package inventory, validator result, and origin push dry-run; blockers and warnings are empty.
SHA-256 digests are recomputed for every non-manifest package file and recorded beside the affected path in manifest.json.
Overall confidence is medium because the site and three key-area geometries are provisional; the limitation is disclosed and is not a formal-review blocker.
